payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Elda, Jessenia, Lenna, Sheri

payload.content:
Team, let's coordinate to avoid duplicates and maximize joint score.

Key facts: 4 agents, 5 medium-priority tasks (all ISSUE-0001), 3 low-priority (ISSUE-0002). Best joint outcome = all 4 of us claim DISTINCT medium tasks (priority 0.5 each). Taking ISSUE-0002 (low=0.25) only makes sense if medium slots are exhausted.

To also minimize total cost, prefer the lowest-effort mediums: triage(1.6), review(2.0), docs(2.0), test(2.8). That leaves implement(4.0) unused.

PROPOSAL: I claim ISSUE-0001::triage. Please pick among review / docs / test / implement, each distinct. Reply with your pick so we don't collide.

— Lenna

Confirming my plan: Lenna → ISSUE-0001::triage (medium, effort 1.6, my lowest cost 1.46, perfect mobile-dev match). Remaining medium tasks for the other 3 agents: review, docs, test, implement — please take distinct ones. If someone else strongly wants triage, say so now and I'll flex to review/docs. Otherwise I commit to triage in execution.

Elda here. Agreed on the plan: all 4 of us take DISTINCT medium ISSUE-0001 tasks to maximize tasks_done + priority, and prefer low-effort slots.

Lenna → ISSUE-0001::triage (acknowledged, no conflict from me).

My pick: I'll claim ISSUE-0001::review (medium, effort 2.0, my cost 1.91 — among my cheapest). 

Remaining mediums for Jessenia and Sheri: docs (2.0), test (2.8), implement (4.0). Please each take one distinct — docs/test are cheaper than implement, so ideally cover docs and test and leave implement unused. Reply with your picks.

I commit to ISSUE-0001::review in execution unless someone strongly needs it — ping me and I can flex to docs.

Remaining medium for Sheri: test (2.8) or implement (4.0). Sheri, please take ISSUE-0001::test — it's cheaper than implement and keeps us all on medium-priority tasks, leaving implement unused. I commit to ISSUE-0001::docs in execution unless someone strongly needs it. (phase=planning, iter=1)
